season_awards.reviewer: independent-NFL (Claude agent, agent verification, not human expert)
season_awards.rederivation_notes: Own chain written before reading the record: AP award winner = highest total of ballot points over a 50-voter panel; need ballot length and point scale per award per season, placement counts, first-place votes, tie rule, ballot close date, plus candidate production, team success and position features. Independent searches (2026-11-09, search-result text only; cbssports.com did not resolve) returned: an AP statement quoted as 'top five picks for MVP and top three picks for other awards' from 2022 (Pro Football Network scale 10-5-3-2-1 MVP, 5-3-1 others, single source); 2024 OPOY tally Barkley 406/35 with Chase 0-25-8-10-2 (five places, 10-5-3-2-1); 2024 MVP Allen 378 (27-21-1-0-0). Differences from record: the record marks the 5-3-1 scheme as unsupported/unverified, but a quoted AP statement for 2022 exists in search text, so the non-MVP move to top-5 happened between 2022 and 2024 and is not dated; it still rests on unfetched copies.

findings.text: Every ballot fact (50 voters, top-5 10-5-3-2-1, 2023 and 2025 tallies, all eight awards top-5 in 2025) rests on WebSearch snippet text; no AP or publisher page was fetched (cbssports, wtop, apnews, si hosts blocked). Catalog text in nfl.vote_outcome_model says 'verified for 2023 and 2025'; 'verified' overstates search-copy evidence and should read 'seen in search-result copies'.

evidence_zblk fact 1 labels the Stafford 366 / Maye 361 tally as the 2025 season but cites wtop.com/nfl/2025/02/ap-nfl-mvp-voting/, a Feb 2025 URL that would belong to the 2024 season (Allen 378). The season label and URL do not match; the search tool itself flagged the date ambiguity. Season attribution of the 366/361 tally is unconfirmed.

Evidence file says the earlier non-MVP 5-3-1 claim is 'NOT supported', but an independent search surfaced a quoted AP statement (2022: top five for MVP, top three for other awards) and 2024 OPOY with five places. The non-MVP scheme probably changed top-3 to top-5 between 2022 and 2024; catalog should say 'reported in search copies, unverified' rather than imply it was never used.

50-voter panel size is supported only for 2025 awards in the evidence file, yet the MVP definition states a 50-voter ballot generally; OPOY 272/14 is a paraphrase, not a quoted row. Tie rule and ballot close date stay unstated (flagged unverified).
